raw_response:
The issuer appears borderline between low investment grade and speculative grade, but the weak liquidity position (current ratio below 1), thin operating profitability (EBIT margin under 4%), and fairly high leverage (liabilities about 74% of assets) tilt the balance toward the low end of the spectrum. Positive retained earnings and a meaningful equity base support some resilience, so I would place it just below investment grade rather than in deeper junk territory.

DECISION: BB+
